# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — Slow Build Hotspots

```html
<h2>Slow Build Hotspots — Find and Fix Gradle Build Bottlenecks</h2>

<p>
  Analyzes your Gradle build profiles to pinpoint slow tasks, cache misses, and
  non-incremental operations — with actionable optimization recommendations that
  deliver measurable build time improvements.
</p>

<h3>Build Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Profile Parsing</b> — Automatically parse Gradle <code>--profile</code> HTML reports</li>
  <li><b>Hotspot Detection</b> — Ranked list of slowest tasks with severity levels (Critical, Slow, Notable)</li>
  <li><b>Cache Miss Analysis</b> — Detect tasks that should be cached but are not</li>
  <li><b>Non-Incremental Detection</b> — Find tasks that rebuild unnecessarily</li>
</ul>

<h3>Visualization</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Performance Dashboard</b> — Visual breakdown of build time by task, phase, and module</li>
  <li><b>Inline Hints</b> — Hotspot annotations directly in build.gradle(.kts) files</li>
  <li><b>Build Health Report</b> — Top 10 slowest tasks, cache hit rate, config vs execution split</li>
  <li><b>Trend Graphs</b> — 30-day build time trends with regression detection (Pro)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Optimization (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Optimization Suggestions</b> — Specific recommendations per task with before/after projections</li>
  <li><b>Unlimited History</b> — Track all builds, not just the last 5</li>
  <li><b>Data Export</b> — Export results as CSV or JSON</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free</b> — Profile parsing, hotspot detection, dashboard, inline hints (top 10), health report, last 5 builds</li>
  <li><b>Pro ($3.90/month)</b> — Optimization suggestions, trend graphs, unlimited history, all inline hints, CSV/JSON export</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.1+)</li>
  <li>Gradle project with <code>--profile</code> support</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Issues: <a href="https://github.com/jakubjirak">GitHub</a></li>
  <li>Email: jakub@jirak.dev</li>
</ul>
```
